call_tracking_fit_ck.name: call_tracking_fit_ck
call_tracking_fit_ck.value: fit_total is null or fit_total between 0 and 100

documents_owner_ck.name: documents_owner_ck
documents_owner_ck.value: (project_id is not null) <> (proposal_id is not null)

expenses_decision_ck.name: expenses_decision_ck
expenses_decision_ck.value:
(status = 'historic' and (recognised_cents is null or recognised_cents between 0 and amount_cents))
    or (status <> 'historic' and (status in ('accepted', 'partially_accepted', 'rejected')) = (recognised_cents is not null)
    and (recognised_cents is null or recognised_cents between 0 and amount_cents)
    and (status <> 'accepted' or recognised_cents = amount_cents)
    and (status <> 'rejected' or recognised_cents = 0)
    and (status <> 'partially_accepted' or (recognised_cents > 0 and recognised_cents < amount_cents)))

expenses_historic_ck.name: expenses_historic_ck
expenses_historic_ck.value:
(source <> 'historic_personnel' or (status = 'historic' and team_member_id is not null))
    and (source = 'historic_personnel' or team_member_id is null) and (external_claim is null or status = 'historic')

project_imports_status_ck.name: project_imports_status_ck
project_imports_status_ck.value: status in ('applied', 'undone') and (status = 'undone') = (undone_at is not null)

proposal_wp_months_ck.name: proposal_wp_months_ck
proposal_wp_months_ck.value: start_month >= 1 and end_month >= start_month and person_months >= 0

reimbursement_claims_preparation_ck.name: reimbursement_claims_preparation_ck
reimbursement_claims_preparation_ck.value: preparation_minutes is null or preparation_minutes between 0 and 600000

risks_scale_ck.name: risks_scale_ck
risks_scale_ck.value: likelihood between 1 and 3 and impact between 1 and 3

team_members_anonymised_ck.name: team_members_anonymised_ck
team_members_anonymised_ck.value: (anonymised_at is null) = (pseudonym is null) and (anonymised_at is null or (user_id is null and full_name = pseudonym))

timesheet_entries_ck.name: timesheet_entries_ck
timesheet_entries_ck.value: day between 1 and 31 and minutes between 0 and 1440
